title: Gen Z demonstrators rally across German cities against government policies
seoTitle: Berlin Gen Z rally against government policies

tea.why: Young people protested against the rising cost of living, underfunded education, military rearmament, and potential mandatory military service.
tea.want: Demonstrators demanded better education facilities, affordable housing, aggressive climate action, and relief from rising living costs.
tea.changed: Oct 31: Youth-led demonstrations organized by 'Gen Z Regelt' took place across German cities, drawing tens of thousands of participants.

summary: On October 31, 2026, a youth-led movement dubbed “Gen Z regelt” (Gen Z takes charge) organized nationwide demonstrations across dozens of German cities, coinciding with Halloween to maximize visibility. Protesters voiced opposition to government economic policies, high living costs, underfunded schools and universities, social spending cuts, environmental concerns, and a potential reintroduction of mandatory military service. In Berlin, approximately 5,000 demonstrators gathered near the Brandenburg Gate, while other rallies took place in cities such as Frankfurt, Munich, Cologne, and Hamburg. While the main gathering in the capital appeared largely peaceful, tensions flared in several other locations where some participants set off fireworks, smoke bombs, and pyrotechnics. Authorities deployed water cannons and riot police in multiple cities, leading to some clashes, property damage, and arrests. Ahead of the events, businesses in major shopping districts boarded up their storefront windows out of concern for potential unrest.
demands: Improved public education and better schools
Opposition to military rearmament and compulsory military service
response: Police deployed extra officers nationwide, used water cannons and riot police in cities like Cologne and Hamburg after fireworks and smoke bombs were used, and made arrests following disturbances, property damage, and attacks on emergency personnel, according to news sources.

updates.text: Youth movement 'Gen Z Regelt' held nationwide demonstrations across more than 30 German cities to protest against government policies.
